bindings.requestId: Every response carries the initiating requestId; both peers reject a mismatch.
bindings.origin: Fill, identity, and save requests carry one normalized page origin. The extension and desktop recheck it before release or write.
bindings.tabIdentity: Not transmitted to the native host. The extension binds the operation to the active tab and window and rechecks both before a page write.
bindings.documentToken: Not transmitted to the native host. The extension creates a single-document token during prepare and requires it again during fill or clear.
bindings.expiry: Not transmitted as caller-controlled data. The desktop owns the 30-second deadline and rechecks the pending request, connection, vault session epoch, and deadline before release.
